comments.body:
Quest name: World Born from Chaos (Chrono Quest - Mythical Era)
Quest location: Seville Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Ecological Research, r10 Biology, r10 Theology
Pre-requisite discovery: Bald Eagle discovery (from "Awe-Inspiring and Majestic Wings" quest) + Statue of Jabdar discovery (from "Mythology of the Snake Deity of Creation" quest)
Additional note: "Indirect branch-off" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain
